Document combined cost in README.

mention_project.eventDescription: One project that cleared the noise gate on a single platform (GitHub trending OR Hacker News OR Product Hunt) but did not reach the momentum bar. Includes the momentum score, the platform it surfaced on, and links.

momentum_project.eventDescription: One project with a momentum score of 40 or higher on a single platform, or any project surfacing on two or more platforms below the breakout bar. Includes per-platform velocity (GitHub stars in period, HN points and comments), score, and links.

breakout_project.eventDescription: One project surfacing on two or more platforms with a combined momentum score of 65 or higher. The strongest emerging-traction signal. Includes full GitHub + Hacker News (+ optional Product Hunt) detail and optional domain WHOIS/MX for outreach. First 3 breakout rows per run are free so you can validate output.
